1: # X1 — Stop Continue Experiment
2: 
3: **Date:** 2026-10-04
4: **Branch:** `pr-06-v2-spike/wo1-stop-continue`
5: **Prototype version:** commit `920e915`

8: ## 1. Experiment Setup
9: 
10: ### Objective
11: Validate that the Antigravity `Stop` hook's `continue` mechanism can be used to harvest turn notes at milestone turns — the most critical validation for the v2 distillation design.
12: 
13: ### Mechanism
14: When a conversation reaches a milestone (the agent stops naturally), the `Stop` hook returns `{"decision": "continue", "reason": "<request>"}`. Antigravity resumes the agent with that request as a system message. The agent writes a turn note. On the next `Stop` (at `executionNum >= 1`), the hook harvests the note from the transcript.
15: 
16: ### Prototype Gate Conditions
17: All conditions must hold for a continue to be issued:
18: 
19: | Condition | Check |
20: |---|---|
21: | v2 spike enabled | `REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=1` |
22: | Normal stop | `terminationReason == "NO_TOOL_CALL"` (case-insensitive) |
23: | Fully idle | `fullyIdle == true` |
24: | First stop | `executionNum == 0` |
25: | Not a subagent | `parentConversationID` is empty |
26: 
27: ### Files Changed
28: - [`hooks.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/hooks.go) — Modified `HandleStop` and `HandleStopEvent` to support v2 continue response; added `V2*` fields to `StopResult`
29: - [`v2_spike_stop.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/v2_spike_stop.go) — New file: gate logic, harvest, note extraction, evidence storage
30: - [`v2_spike_stop_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/v2_spike_stop_test.go) — 10 unit tests covering all gate conditions and harvest paths
31: 
32: ## 2. Unit Test Results
33: 
34: All 10 v2 spike tests pass:
35: 
36: | Test | Result |
37: |---|---|
38: | `DisabledByDefault` — no continue when env var unset | ✅ |
39: | `ContinueOnFirstStop` — continue on first stop with all gates passing | ✅ |
40: | `SkipWhenNotFullyIdle` — no continue when `fullyIdle=false` | ✅ |
41: | `SkipWhenWrongTerminationReason` — no continue for non-`NO_TOOL_CALL` | ✅ |
42: | `SkipSubagent` — no continue for subagents | ✅ |
43: | `CaseInsensitiveTerminationReason` — handles `no_tool_call`, `No_Tool_Call`, etc. | ✅ |
44: | `HarvestOnSecondStop` — extracts note from transcript on harvest pass | ✅ |
45: | `HarvestNoneResponse` — handles `NONE` response gracefully | ✅ |
46: | `NoConversationID` — no continue when conversation ID is empty | ✅ |
47: | `HandleStop_ContinueResponse` — correct JSON response marshalling | ✅ |
48: 
49: ## 3. Local CLI Verification
50: 
51: ### Continue trigger (v2 spike active)
52: ```
53: $ echo '{"conversationId":"test-123","terminationReason":"NO_TOOL_CALL","fullyIdle":true,"executionNum":0,...}' \
54:   | REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=1 ./repo-memory hook antigravity stop
55: 
56: [repo-memory v2-spike] Gate PASSED: requesting continue for test-123
57: {"decision":"continue","reason":"repo-memory: before you stop, ..."}
58: ```
59: 
60: ### Normal mode (v2 spike off)
61: ```
62: $ echo '...' | ./repo-memory hook antigravity stop
63: {}
64: ```
65: 
66: ### Subagent skip
67: ```
68: $ echo '{"parentConversationId":"parent-123",...}' | REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=1 ./repo-memory hook antigravity stop
69: 
70: [repo-memory v2-spike] Gate skip: subagent (parent=parent-123)
71: {}
72: ```
73: 
74: ## 4. Live Experiment Results
75: 
76: > [!IMPORTANT]
77: > The live experiment requires setting `export REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=1` and running ≥ 20 requests through Antigravity with the prototype installed.

88: - **Median token cost per note:** _(pending)_ (target: ≤ 10k uncached input tokens)
89: - **Interleaving observed:** _(pending)_

92: ## 5. X1 Criteria Assessment
93: 
94: | Criterion | Target | Result | Status |
95: |---|---|---|---|
96: | Success rate | ≥ 95% of ≥ 20 requests | _(pending)_ | ⏳ |
97: | Token cost per note | Median uncached input ≤ 10k tokens | _(pending)_ | ⏳ |

99: | PA/worker sessions | Continue doesn't disrupt PA loop | _(pending)_ | ⏳ |
100: | `max_stop_hook_continuations` | Document the limit | _(pending)_ | ⏳ |
101: 
102: ## 6. Findings
103: 
104: ### 6.1 Design Conformance
105: The prototype implements the core of §5.1 (Turn notes):
106: - **Gate:** Deterministic, sub-millisecond evaluation of all conditions
107: - **Request:** Uses the draft wording from the design doc
108: - **Harvest:** Reads the transcript and extracts `repo-memory-note` blocks
109: - **Subagent skip:** Detects subagents via `parentConversationID`
110: - **Failure handling:** Tool calls in the response, or missing note blocks, are recorded as failures
111: 
112: ### 6.2 Deferred from Prototype
113: The following §5.1 features are not in the X1 prototype (they require the full v2 implementation):
114: - **Milestone detection** (git commits, PR opens, etc.) — prototype fires on every qualifying stop
115: - **Cooldown and daily cap** — not implemented
116: - **Mark tracking** — not implemented (mark/cursor state)
117: - **Checkpoint-aware note titles** — not implemented
118: - **Autonomous goal/workflow detection** — not implemented
119: 
120: ### 6.3 Response Format Discovery
121: The design doc says `{"decision": "continue", "reason": "<request>"}`. The WORKORDER said `{"continue": true, "request": "..."}`. Based on the codebase's existing `{"decision": "allow", "reason": "..."}` pattern for PreToolUse hooks, and the design doc's §2.3 evidence noting *"Stop returning continue appends the system message 'stop hook blocked termination due to reason: …'"*, the correct format is `{"decision": "continue", "reason": "..."}`.
